_help: All on-screen text lives here. To translate, copy this file (e.g. to fr.json) and translate the right-hand side only. {curly} words are filled in by the game. A [list] means the game picks one of the lines, so results feel varied.
app.title: Kitchenria
app.tagline: a cosy kitchen where you cook anything
top.clearHint: Put everything on the counter back in the pantry
shelf.title: Pantry
table.label: Kitchen counter
table.hint: Drag ingredients from the pantry onto the counter. Drop food onto food to stack it. Then grab a hand tool from the wall (hands knead, the whisk whisks…) and drop it on your stack, or put the food in the pot, pan or oven. When it looks delicious, put it on the plate and press Serve!
tool.slotLabel: {name} in the {tool}. Press to take it back out.
chip.label: {name} on the counter. Press Enter to pick it up, Delete to put it away.
tile.label: {name}. Press Enter to put it on the counter.
review.title: The critic's verdict
review.again: You've served this before. The critic remembers it fondly.

critic.open.3: I see what you're going for.
critic.good.signature: A true classic, made with respect.
critic.good.technique: You clearly know your way around a kitchen.
So many techniques, all used well.
critic.good.complex: Layers of flavour, one after another.
critic.good.warm: Served warm, the way comfort food should be.
critic.good.sweetSalty: That sweet and salty dance? Delightful.
critic.good.fresh: It tastes like a sunny garden.
critic.good.sweet: A sweet treat to make anyone smile.
critic.good.plated: Well composed, with a thoughtful side.
The plate tells a little story.
critic.good.cool: Refreshingly cold. Just what I needed.
critic.bad.raw: Some of this needed cooking. My tummy is worried.
critic.bad.burnt: I can taste the smoke alarm.
The burnt bits have their own burnt bits.
critic.bad.salty: Too salty! I need a glass of water.
Did the salt shaker fall in?
critic.bad.bland: A little plain. It needs some personality.
Polite, but a bit shy on flavour.
critic.bad.busy: So many things at once! My poor taste buds.
Too many cooks, too many ingredients.
critic.bad.lonely: Just one raw ingredient on a plate. Very... minimalist.
critic.bad.weird: I have never seen anything like it. That's not a compliment.
critic.verdict.4: I would happily order this again.
critic.verdict.2: Keep practising, I believe in you.
critic.verdict.1: I'll stick to tea, thank you.
critic.verdict.0: I'm going to need a nap.
